NFR3.1.decision: Render-every-event subscription — initiate on mount and re-establish on reconnect; apply every delivered event

NFR3.2.decision: No measured target; values appear as soon as the browser renders them

NFR3.3.decision: Render each event as it arrives; no coalescing, no throttle

NFR3.4.decision: Client-owned reconnection with 1s → 2s → 4s → 8s, capped at 30s; attempt counter visible; malformed frames ignored without breaking recovery

NFR3.5.decision: Last known values marked stale; connection indicator shows disconnected; timestamp stops advancing; stale clears on first new valid event

NFR1.2.requirement: Safe rendering of telemetry and errors
NFR1.2.decision: React-escaped text; no dangerouslySetInnerHTML; malformed/non-JSON payloads dropped and logged to console.error without rendering

NFR1.3.decision: OPENROUTER_API_KEY stays in U1's .env; U3 never calls OpenRouter directly; CI bundle scan targets specific secret patterns in dist/

NFR1.4.decision: No token or credential in handshake; always-visible LanRiskBanner in StatsPanel displays accepted LAN risk covering telemetry and chat commands

NFR1.5.decision: Fields absent or null render as dash; aligns with BR1.5.3

US1.4.decision: StatsPanel, ConnectionStatus, event counter, and stale/reconnect indicators designed to satisfy observability acceptance criteria

US1.5.requirement: Error handling and rephrase (AC1.5.1–AC1.5.4 partial — error display)
US1.5.decision: ErrorDisplay component designed to render error type/message/timestamp for errors surfaced to U3; chat-UI ownership clarified as consumed surface

Contract_2.decision: U3 consumes RobotStateChanged via WebSocket with at-most-once/no-replay assumption and reconnect/stale behavior per NFR3
